name: all-your-agents
description: Event-driven, harness-neutral API for live coding-agent sessions

scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p tsconfig.types.json && node --test 'dist-test/test/**/*.test.js'
scripts.test:coverage: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p tsconfig.types.json && c8 --src src --all --exclude src/testing/** --exclude src/helpers/process-watch-worker.ts --reporter=text --reporter=text-summary --reporter=html node --test 'dist-test/test/**/*.test.js'
